page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the right margin beside the line "in unita-te". The running head "PARS PRIMA." and the page number "31" are at the top. A psalm title and verse heading sit above the first paragraph of Psalm 122's commentary. At the foot, the catchword "plo" stands at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: ritu excellentiæ suò, & lecturos omnes afficiat eiusdem excellentiæ suæ studio ac conscientiâ, ut viam excellentem hanc insistamus omnes, & ad finem perfectionemque illius uno animo contendamus in Christo Iesu unico, æterno, & perfecto seruatore nostro. Cùm autem duo capita de Pace receperimus, ante[?] nos esse dicturos: Unum, de Re & Modo ipsius: Alterum, de Fructibus: Iam auctore Domino venturi sumus ad prioris explicationem, prout verba nobis sanctus ille Dei Spiritus præiuit olim per Dauidem Psalmo 122. & nobis in eundem Psalmum dicendi gratiam admensurus est.
main_text.head: PSALMVS. 122.
1. Lætor de dicentibus mihi, Eamus in domum Iehoue.
main_text.p: Huius psalmi Finis est, ut Deus in Ecclesia sua glorificetur intus fide, foris obsequio fidei omnibusq. officiis pietatis, in unita-teRom.14. Spiritus per vinculum pacis. Summa est, Fructum Spiritus in omnibus piis esse gaudium spirituale, & pacem in iustitia; quam pacem Deus in Christo publicè dedit ecclesiæ, & singulis membris illius, in se, atq. inter se colendâ cum Deo, & secundum Deum. Partes itaque duæ sunt: Nam primùm loquitur Psaltes de spirituali piorum gaudio in Christo & ecclesiâ eius: ad quod gaudium omnes homines sermone salutis & exem-

page.notes: The printed "Hvivs" has a large initial H; read as Huius with u/v corrected. The word "ante" after "receperimus" is partly obscured by the printed comma and is marked [?]. The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and show-through, not transcribed. The faint handwritten figures top right are not printed text and are left out. The line "exem-" ends the text; "plo" below right is the catchword, the start of the next page's word "exemplo".
